summary: BytesMut::reserve_inner incorrectly derives the buffer offset from the difference between vector and view capacities. After split_off truncates the view capacity, this calculation points to the wrong bytes when reallocating a uniquely held shared vector. The fix computes the actual pointer offset, preserving the buffer contents. The fix-added test reserve_shared_reuse in tests/test_bytes.rs exercises this case. No builds or tests were run.
expected_failure: assertion failed: `(left == right)` at the content assertion following bytes.reserve(2000)

reversal.fixed_text: let off = (self.ptr.as_ptr() as usize) - (v.as_ptr() as usize);
